name: Kurusu Aria
source: Aria is a sister and a battlefield comrade of Machina, and she is also the user of Demonic Ark that controls destruction. Aria's characteristics are that of uneven temper and seductress. She loves doing lewd stuff to her sister. She is Karen's senior but refuses to fight along side her because she believes Karen is an indirect cause to Machina's loss.
